hook.line: Every news story is built on numbers: how much something grew, what fraction of people did it, roughly how many turned up. Spanish reports use a small kit for this.
hook.es: La población se duplicó en diez años.
hook.en: The population doubled in ten years.

examples.es: Las ventas cayeron en torno a un 15 %.
La población se duplicó en diez años.
examples.en: The population doubled in ten years.

examples.es: El precio se redujo a la mitad.
Un tercio de los estudiantes no votó.
examples.en: A third of the students didn't vote.
Close to a thousand people attended.

examples.es: Los clientes se triplicaron este año.

rule:
For change, Spanish adds *se* to the verb: *se duplicó* (doubled), *se triplicó* (tripled), *se redujo a la mitad* (was halved). The verb agrees with what changed: *los clientes se triplicaron*.

For fractions: *un tercio de*, *dos tercios de*, *la mitad de*, then *los* and the group.

For "around": *en torno a* or *cerca de*, then the figure.
smallPrint: Teachers call this the language of describing figures and trends. *Se duplicó* is the reflexive passive that you already know from *se vende*.

readAndPick.es: Las ventas se duplicaron este año.
options: Sales halved this year.
Sales doubled this year.
Sales tripled this year.

readAndPick.es: El precio del tinto se redujo a la mitad.
options: The price of black coffee doubled.
The price of black coffee fell by a third.
The price of black coffee was halved.

readAndPick.es: Dos tercios de los vecinos votaron.
options: One third of the neighbours voted.
Two thirds of the neighbours voted.
Half of the neighbours voted.

readAndPick.es: Los turistas se triplicaron en diez años.
options: Tourists tripled in ten years.
Tourists doubled in ten years.
Tourists were halved in ten years.
Exactly a thousand people attended.
Close to a thousand people attended.
More than a thousand people attended.

readAndPick.es: Un tercio de los estudiantes no votó.
options: A third of the students didn't vote.
Two thirds of the students didn't vote.
Half of the students didn't vote.

readAndPick.es: La población se duplicó en veinte años.
options: The population tripled in twenty years.
The population was halved in twenty years.
The population doubled in twenty years.

readAndPick.es: Las ventas cayeron en torno a un 15 %.
options: Sales rose by around 15%.
Sales fell by exactly 15%.
Sales fell by around 15%.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *El precio ___ a la mitad.* (*se redujo* or *se duplicó*) The price was halved.
yourTurn.answer: El precio se redujo a la mitad.
yourTurn.why: *A la mitad* means "to half", so the verb is *se redujo*.

yourTurn.prompt: Pick and type the whole sentence: *La población ___ en diez años.* (*se duplicó* or *se redujo*) The population doubled in ten years.
yourTurn.answer: La población se duplicó en diez años.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: A third of the students didn't vote.
yourTurn.answer: Un tercio de los estudiantes no votó.
accept: Un tercio de los estudiantes no votaron.
yourTurn.why: *Un tercio de* is followed by *los* and the group.

yourTurn.answer: Las ventas cayeron en torno a un 15 %.
accept: Las ventas cayeron en torno a un 15%.
yourTurn.why: "Around" is *en torno a*, followed by the figure.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: Close to a thousand people attended.
accept: En torno a mil personas asistieron.
yourTurn.why: *Cerca de* gives an approximate number, just like "close to".

yourTurn.prompt: Change *Las ventas se duplicaron* so that the customers tripled.
accept: Los clientes del café se triplicaron.
yourTurn.why: The verb agrees with the thing that changed: *los clientes se triplicaron*.

yourTurn.prompt: Say: Two thirds of the neighbours voted.
yourTurn.answer: Dos tercios de los vecinos votaron.

pitfalls.wrong: La población duplicó en diez años.
pitfalls.right: La población se duplicó en diez años.
pitfalls.why: Almost. When something grows by itself, Spanish adds *se*: *se duplicó*.

pitfalls.wrong: Un tercio de estudiantes no votó.
pitfalls.right: Un tercio de los estudiantes no votó.
pitfalls.why: Spanish keeps the article after *de*: *de los estudiantes*.

pitfalls.wrong: El precio se redujo la mitad.
pitfalls.right: El precio se redujo a la mitad.
pitfalls.why: You need the *a*: *se redujo a la mitad*.

personal: Write a headline about your town or your workplace with a real change in it, using *se duplicó*, *se triplicó* or *un tercio de*, and add an approximate figure with *cerca de* or *en torno a*.
